For a general number of columns, we should only be incrementing the `yPosition` when `index + 1 % columns == 0` (in other words, this is the last item in the row).

This works for 2 columns, since we only visit the `else` once for each row, but it wouldn't for 3 or more columns.
If I'm reading this correctly, I think you don't have to have the special case for one column, since `index % 1` will always equal 0.


Ah, this `x` logic is also not quite general enough for more than 2 columns: We need to keep a running position for the entire row.

I think we can use `chunked` to clean this up a bit more too:
```suggestion
            placeables.chunked(columns).forEachIndexed { rowIndex, row ->
                var xPosition = 0
                row.forEach { placeable ->
                    placeable.placeRelative(x = xPosition, y = yPosition)
                    xPosition += placeable.width + itemSpacingPx
                }
                yPosition += rowHeights[rowIndex]
            }
```
